utterances.speaker: MR. NIKOLIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Your Honour. My name is Zarko Nikolic. I'm representing Admiral Jokic. JUDGE WEINBERG DE ROCA: Thank you. Mr. Jokic. Can you hear and understand me? THE APPELLANT: [Interpretation] Yes, Your Honour, I can hear you and I can understand you. JUDGE WEINBERG DE ROCA: Thank you very much. For the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MR. FARRELL
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. Good afternoon, Mr. Nikolic. Appearing for the Prosecution is Norman Farrell, Ms. Susan Lamb, and with me as our case manager is Ms. Lourdes Galicia. JUDGE WEINBERG DE ROCA: Thank you very much. Now I will give the floor to Mr. Nikolic if there's any special issue that you want to raise at this Status Conference.

utterances.speaker: MR. NIKOLIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] This Status Conference has been convened pursuant to Rule 65 bis (B). And at this point, Your Honour, the Defence has no issues to raise in connection with the appeal that has been lodged. JUDGE WEINBERG DE ROCA: Thank you very much, Mr. Nikolic. Mr. Farrell, is there any issue you want to raise?

utterances.speaker: MR. FARRELL
utterances.text: No, thank you, Your Honour. JUDGE WEINBERG DE ROCA: Then this is a very quick Status Conference. I thank you all for your appearances. And the Status Conference is adjourned. Thank you very much.
